_comment: Initial source registry, loaded by `python -m app.cli seed-sources` (existing keys are not overwritten). Every source was checked manually on 2026-10-18 before being added; see docs/SOURCES.md.

sources.name: National Scholarship Portal — All Scholarships listing
sources.organization: Ministry of Electronics & IT / NSP (Government of India)
sources.trust_policy: Authoritative for the application window (open date / student deadline) and guideline links of central schemes hosted on NSP. Not authoritative for eligibility details, which live in the linked guideline PDFs.
sources.access_notes: Public, server-rendered HTML. robots.txt returns 404 (no restrictions published). No ETag; Cache-Control: no-store, so change detection uses content hashes. No public API or sitemap found.

sources.name: AICTE Swanath Scholarship — official guideline PDF (NSP-hosted)
sources.trust_policy: Authoritative for Swanath (degree) eligibility rules. PDF supports ETag/Last-Modified.
sources.access_notes: Public PDF with a text layer (no OCR needed).

sources.name: DEPwD — Post-Matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities
sources.organization: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities
sources.trust_policy: Authoritative summary of eligibility for this scheme.

sources.name: Tata Trusts — Individual education grants page
sources.trust_policy: Scheme owner's page; authoritative for its own open/closed statement.
sources.access_notes: robots.txt only disallows /manage. Page covers several Tata programmes; closure statements are matched sentence-by-sentence and queued for review, not auto-applied.

sources.name: Reliance Foundation — Scholarships 2026-27 announcement
sources.trust_policy: Scheme owner's announcement; describes both the UG (IND-PRI-001) and PG (IND-PRI-002) programmes.

sources.name: Reliance Foundation Scholarships portal
sources.trust_policy: Would be authoritative, but cannot be read without JavaScript rendering.
sources.access_notes: DISABLED: the page body is rendered client-side (no readable text in the HTML). Browser rendering is not configured; the announcement page above is monitored instead.
